decisions.reason: Setting up the cover page, table of contents, and general layout before final content arrives does not change the requirement to integrate photos into the final proposal.
The conditional use of supplied branding documents does not change the already established Agua Arc identity or its logo and color assets.
Pre-content setup of general document elements does not alter the requirement to integrate supplied tables into the final proposal draft.
The accepted scheduling terms from the same exchange are already represented by the candidate's message 58 MODIFY; the layout setup decision adds no further schedule change.
Early setup of layout elements does not change the required print-ready PDF delivery format.
The proposal to begin layout after receiving branding documents does not change Canva ownership, edit access, asset policy, or source-file delivery.
Preparing layout elements before narrative content arrives does not change the requirement to package all supplied narrative content into one document.
The source decision concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and has no effect on the TPEC proposal design requirement.
The accepted pre-content layout setup does not change the established single revision round.
Setting up preliminary document elements does not change the anticipated proposal page count.
